import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    oi_target = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    oi_orders = oi_target.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_status", "order_purchase_timestamp",
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )

    # История: только покупки, совершённые до seed_time
    oi_hist = oi_orders[oi_orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
    window_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    oi_90 = oi_hist[oi_hist["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= window_90].copy()

    # 1. Исторические агрегаты
    agg_hist = oi_hist.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_sold=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
        total_revenue=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="sum"),
        total_freight_cost=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum"),
        avg_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="mean"),
        avg_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        first_sale_date=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_purchase_timestamp", aggfunc="min"),
        last_sale_date=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_purchase_timestamp", aggfunc="max"),
        num_unique_sellers=pd.NamedAgg(column="seller_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
        num_unique_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
    ).reset_index()
    agg_hist["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - agg_hist["last_sale_date"]).dt.days
    agg_hist["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - agg_hist["first_sale_date"]).dt.days
    agg_hist["avg_units_per_order"] = np.where(
        agg_hist["num_unique_orders"] > 0,
        agg_hist["total_units_sold"] / agg_hist["num_unique_orders"], 0.0)
    agg_hist = agg_hist.drop(columns=["first_sale_date", "last_sale_date"])

    # 2. Последние 90 дней
    agg_90 = oi_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        units_sold_90d=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
        revenue_90d=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="sum"),
        avg_price_90d=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="mean"),
        num_orders_90d=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
    ).reset_index()

    # 3. Последние 30 дней (тренд)
    window_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    oi_30 = oi_hist[oi_hist["order_purchase_timestamp"] >= window_30]
    agg_30 = oi_30.groupby("product_id").agg(
        units_sold_30d=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
        num_orders_30d=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
    ).reset_index()

    # 4. Признаки доставки: используем только заказы, доставка которых
    #    уже произошла ДО seed_time (иначе информация из будущего)
    oi_delivered = oi_hist[
        oi_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna()
        & (oi_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()
    oi_delivered["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        oi_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - oi_delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.days
    oi_delivered["delivery_duration_days"] = (
        oi_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - oi_delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    agg_delivery = oi_delivered.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_delivery_delay=pd.NamedAgg(column="delivery_delay_days", aggfunc="mean"),
        avg_delivery_duration=pd.NamedAgg(column="delivery_duration_days", aggfunc="mean"),
        num_delivered=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="count"),
    ).reset_index()

    # 5. Отзывы: только отзывы, уже созданные до seed_time
    rev_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time]
    order_product = oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates()
    rev_product = rev_hist.merge(order_product, on="order_id", how="inner")
    agg_review = rev_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="mean"),
        num_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_id", aggfunc="count"),
        pct_low_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(
            column="review_score",
            aggfunc=lambda x: (x <= 2).sum() / len(x) if len(x) > 0 else 0.0),
    ).reset_index()

    # 6. Платежи: только платежи, совершённые до seed_time
    pay_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time]
    order_pay = pay_hist.merge(
        oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id", how="inner")
    agg_pay = order_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_payment_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        avg_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="mean"),
        pct_credit_card=pd.NamedAgg(
            column="payment_type",
            aggfunc=lambda x: (x == "credit_card").sum() / len(x) if len(x) > 0 else 0.0),
    ).reset_index()

    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)})
    features = (
        base
        .merge(agg_hist, on="product_id", how="left")
        .merge(agg_90, on="product_id", how="left")
        .merge(agg_30, on="product_id", how="left")
        .merge(agg_delivery, on="product_id", how="left")
        .merge(agg_review, on="product_id", how="left")
        .merge(agg_pay, on="product_id", how="left")
    )

    fill_0 = ["total_units_sold", "total_revenue", "total_freight_cost",
              "units_sold_90d", "revenue_90d", "num_orders_90d",
              "units_sold_30d", "num_orders_30d",
              "num_delivered", "num_reviews", "num_unique_orders"]
    fill_neg1 = ["days_since_last_sale", "days_since_first_sale"]
    fill_05 = ["pct_low_reviews", "pct_credit_card"]
    fill_0num = ["avg_price", "avg_freight", "avg_price_90d",
                 "avg_delivery_delay", "avg_delivery_duration",
                 "avg_review_score", "avg_payment_value",
                 "avg_installments", "num_unique_sellers",
                 "avg_units_per_order"]

    features[fill_0] = features[fill_0].fillna(0).astype(np.int64)
    features[fill_neg1] = features[fill_neg1].fillna(-1).astype(np.int64)
    features[fill_05] = features[fill_05].fillna(0.5).astype(np.float64)
    features[fill_0num] = features[fill_0num].fillna(0.0).astype(np.float64)

    features["has_any_sales"] = (features["total_units_sold"] > 0).astype(np.int8)
    features["units_90d_share"] = np.where(
        features["total_units_sold"] == 0, 0.0,
        features["units_sold_90d"] / features["total_units_sold"]).astype(np.float64)
    features["units_30d_share_90d"] = np.where(
        features["units_sold_90d"] == 0, 0.0,
        features["units_sold_30d"] / features["units_sold_90d"]).astype(np.float64)
    features["sales_per_seller"] = np.where(
        features["num_unique_sellers"] == 0, 0.0,
        features["total_units_sold"] / features["num_unique_sellers"]).astype(np.float64)
    features["sales_velocity_90d"] = features["units_sold_90d"] / 90.0
    features["recency_weighted"] = np.where(
        features["days_since_last_sale"] < 0, 0.0,
        np.exp(-features["days_since_last_sale"].clip(lower=0) / 30.0)).astype(np.float64)

    features = features.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])
    return features
